title: Gauntlet-like object with moving hieroglyphic symbols
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: it almost looked like a mirage type of effect and in that above that display screen were these hieroglyphic symbols that I started to see appear

plain: Randy Anderson says that in 2014, at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy base in Indiana, he saw an object shaped something like a gauntlet, an armoured glove, with a display screen, and above the screen symbols like hieroglyphs began to appear and move. He tells Michels it "almost looked like a mirage type of effect" and that he watched "these hieroglyphic symbols that I started to see appear." He gives it as something he saw himself, and if true it would mean a strange, non-human-looking device was being held at a US military base.
